title: Editorial Comment to Supervised machine learning algorithm identified KRT20, BATF and TP63 as biologically relevant biomarkers for bladder biopsy specimens from interstitial cystitis/bladder pain syndrome patients.
journal: International journal of urology : official journal of the Japanese Urological Association
one_liner_zh: 该文是膀胱活检生物标志物（KRT20、BATF、TP63）的监督机器学习分类研究，虽涉及转录因子BATF/TP63，但无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或结合机制研究，仅临床生物标志物筛选，与本课题核心无关。
